schedule: Refreshed three times a day (6:37, 12:37 and 18:37 ET) by a scheduled research run.
live_note: Day three ends as it began: enormous attack traffic, a botnet riding on it, and still no confirmed breach. CISA updated its exploited-flaws catalog on Friday afternoon and left the PHP bugs out. The experts' view, per The Record, is that most public exploits only work in labs, but one vendor has a production-grade exploit and Cobalt's CISO calls the lull 'borrowed time'. Most exposed servers run versions that will never be fixed.
live_since_label: hours since the PHP fix shipped (Oct 21, about 14:00 UTC)

changelog.text: 19:45 ET: 2 incidents added (ransomware affiliates running intrusions through an AI agent, per SOCRadar; a federal judge's AI-drafted order vacated and the judge removed by the Fifth Circuit on Oct 22). 1 incident updated (UK AISI test runs: Anthropic's own assessment, "a serious failure of alignment"). PHP2Shell: 2 timeline events, 4 statements, 1 scale figure added; CISA KEV re-checked, updated Oct 23 without the PHP CVEs. 2 case statuses updated (OpenAI now trains offline; AISI runs). 5 quotes added (66 total). The Wire: 9 stories added, siren moved to Anthropic's assessment.

PHP2Shell: third PHP bug (CVE-2026-115560), VulnCheck production-config exploit, Qualys patch-rate figures and Hunt.io findings added (5 timeline events, 3 statements, 3 scale figures); CISA KEV re-checked, still not listed. 3 quotes added to In their words (61 total).

Launched at warningshots.ai. Added "In their words": 58 verbatim, source-verified quotes from the people in charge, with pull quotes in each incident. Added the daily brief, embeddable charts and share tools.

Added deep dives for six multi-victim incidents (146 organizations), 103 official statements, and PHP2Shell as incident 133.
